y-m-44-04.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Saddex-geeye wuxuu samaysmaa marka saddexda bar ee is-goynta ay yihiin saddex bar oo kala duwan oo keliya. Maxaa dhici lahaa haddii is-goynta saddexda xariiq ay isku biiraan hal?
y-m-44-04.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Saddexda xariiq dhammaantood waxay noqdaan isla xariiq, sidaas darteed saddex-geeye ma samaysmo
y-m-44-04.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Jaleecooyinka saddexda xariiq way kala duwan yihiin: 1, −1, 2, sidaas darteed waligood ma noqon karaan isla xariiq.
y-m-44-04.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Saddexda xariiq waxay ku kulmaan hal bar (2, 3), sidaas darteed saddex-geeye ma samaysmo
y-m-44-04.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Waxaad tilmaantay inay ku kulmaan hal bar, sidaas darteed saddexda bar ee is-goynta ayaa is-dulsaaray hal.
y-m-44-04.s.s1.st.2.info: Markan ha noqdo k = 3. Is-goynta l₁ iyo l₃ waa (4, 5), is-goynta l₂ iyo l₃ waa (8/3, 7/3), is-goynta l₁ iyo l₂ na waa (2, 3). Saddexdan bar waa geesaha saddex-geeyaha.
y-m-44-04.s.s1.st.2.ask: Marka k = 3, waa maxay bedka saddex-geeyaha ay ku xidhan yihiin saddexda xariiq?
y-m-44-04.s.s1.st.2.after: Adigoo isticmaalaya saddexda geesood (2, 3), (4, 5), (8/3, 7/3), bedku waa 4/3. Helidda is-goynta laba xariiq, hubinta haddii ay ku kulmaan hal bar, iyo helidda bedka saddex-geeye dhammaantood way isku xidhan yihiin.
y-m-44-04.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Qiimahani waa laba jeer qiime qaar. Hubi haddii aad ilowday tallaabada badhka marka la helayo bedka saddex-geeye.
y-m-44-04.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Geli isku-duubyada saddexda geesood oo mar kale xisaabi. Waxaa laga yaabaa inaad si khaldan u doortay salka iyo sarrayn.
y-m-44-04.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Waxaad heshay bedka isku-duubyada saddexda geesood.
y-m-44-04.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Tani waxay u egtahay wax-isku-dhufashada farqiyada isku-duubyada sida ay yihiin. Saddex-geeye waa badh afargeeye dhinac-dheer.
y-m-44-04.s.s1.reflect: Bilowga way fududahay in la moodo 'haddii aysan is-barbar-socon, saddex-geeye ayaa samaysma'. Sidee xukunkaagu u isbeddelay tallaabo kasta? Tallaabadee ayaa 'kalsoonidaadu' kortay marka macluumaadku kordhay, tallaabadee na 'shuruudaha' ayaa kordhay?
y-m-44-04.s.s2.prompt: Hel dhammaan kiisaska (imisa ayaa jira?) saddexda xariiq ay samayn kari waayaan saddex-geeye iyadoo ku xidhan qiimaha k, oo hal ama laba weedh ku qor sababta.
y-m-44-04.s.s2.hint.0: Marka hore hel is-goynta l₁ iyo l₂, ka dibna hel k ka dhigaya l₃ inuu maro barta taas.
y-m-44-04.s.s2.hint.1: Dooro hal qiime oo k ah oo kale oo hubi haddii saddexda bar ee is-goynta ay noqdaan kuwo midba midka kale ka duwan.

y-m-44-04.s.s2.model.0: Ma samaysmo marka k = 1 oo keliya. Markaas saddexda xariiq dhammaantood waxay maraan hal bar (2, 3), sidaas darteed saddexda bar ee is-goynta ayaa is-dulsaaray hal. Jaleecooyinku dhammaantood way kala duwan yihiin, sidaas darteed kiis is-barbar-socod ma jiro.
y-m-44-04.s.s2.model.1: Kiiska keliya waa marka l₃ uu maro is-goynta (2, 3) ee l₁ iyo l₂, taasi waa, marka k yahay 1. Markaas saddexda xariiq waxay ku kulmaan hal bar oo saddex-geeye ma sameeyaan. K kale kasta, is-goyntu waa saddex bar oo kala duwan.
